title: 乌克兰百万级法院判决引用图谱的自动构建与分析
summary: 从1.007亿份乌克兰法院判决中提取5.02亿条引用链接，构建首个大规模法律引用图谱。发现引用结构无监督地编码法律领域边界，并以近乎完美的准确率预测未来立法重要性。将引用本体作为LLM辅助法律分析的工作流记忆系统的领域层。
summary_en: Constructed the first large-scale legal citation graph from 100.7 million Ukrainian court decisions, extracting 502 million citation links. Found that citation structure encodes legal domain boundaries without supervision and predicts legislative importance with near-perfect accuracy. The citation-derived ontology is operationalized as the domain layer of a workflow memory system for LLM-assisted legal analysis.
